sentences.text: Akash Alias Akku vs State Of Uttarakhand on 8 October, 2024

Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 First Bail Application No.1875 of 2023
Akash alias Akku ........Applicant
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand ........Respondent

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Present:-
Mr. Deep Chandra Joshi, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Pramod Tiwari, Brief Holder for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

Applicant is in judicial custody in Fir No.137 of 2023, under Sections 365, 366, 376 Ipc & Section
5/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, Police Station Ramnagar, District
Nainital.
He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, on 01.04.2023, the applicant enticed the victim, who is a young girl.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the victim has already been examined at trial.
She has stated that they were in romantic relationship and they had left their house on their own so that they could marry.
They established physical relationship also.
5. It is argued that, in fact, the mother of the victim has also stated that the applicant and the victim both were in romantic relationship.
Learned counsel would submit that the date of birth of the victim is 20.03.2005 in the school scholar register.

He would also submit that mother of the victim has been re-examined on 31.08.2014, when she has categorically stated that in the school scholar register, the date of birth of the victim is 20.03.2005.
On 09.09.2024, the Court required from the learned State Counsel to get instructions with regard to the date of birth of the victim.
6. Learned State Counsel would submit that the applicant and the victim both were in relationship as told by the victim.
He would submit that as per instructions, in the school scholar register of the Sun Rise Public School, Bharatpuri, Ramnagar, the date of birth of the victim is 20.03.2005.
7. The age of the victim has been disputed.
The applicant and the victim both were in romantic relationship.
It is admitted by the victim also.

9. The bail application is allowed.
10. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court concerned.
